headline: Apollo Global Management (APO) Backs Keppel Offshore Fund, Is The Stock Fully Priced?
summary: Apollo Global Management (APO) recently agreed for Apollo managed funds and affiliates to invest US$1.5b into Keppel Offshore Fund, a rated investment grade vehicle focused on offshore energy assets in Southeast Asia. headline: Can Apollo (APO) Turn Permanent Capital Into an Edge With Its Offshore Energy and Events Bet?
summary: Apollo-managed funds recently completed the acquisitions of Emerald Holding and Questex, and agreed to invest US$1.50 billion into Keppel’s Offshore Fund, creating a larger B2B events platform and expanding exposure to Southeast Asia’s offshore energy assets. This combination of platform-building in events and a very large capital commitment to offshore energy highlights Apollo’s use of permanent capital to back sector-specific operating businesses.
